command: Assess GO:0007189 adenylate cyclase-activating GPCR signaling for human LPAR2 Q9HBW0 and LPAR3 Q9UBY5 separately. Actual PTHR22750 tree places both inside positive PTN002733616; LPAR2 has two repeated accession leaves PTN009051918/PTN002503555 and LPAR3 PTN002503536, all descending from that node. Donor count, one predominant Gi pathway, or absence of a human-native assay does not establish function loss. Full primary10488122 Methods/Results/Fig7 (author-deposited ResearchGate text accessible) shows human EDG4 and EDG7 enhance forskolin-stimulated cAMP in Sf9 cells, PTX insensitive; assay includes 5uM forskolin and 0.5mM IBMX, then LPA. LPA alone was ineffective. GO7189 does not explicitly require Gs or universal activation in every cellular context. Full primary10727522 (indexed publisher full text) contrasts this with mammalian Rh7777 cAMP and HEK293T Gi2alpha/GTPgammaS assays, and proposes conditional cyclase-II/PKC mechanisms as a possible explanation, not a refutation. Read the complete assays and controls, receptor constructs and their sequences, and later primary coupling studies. Bandoh cloned EDG4 from human brain cDNA, not explicitly the initial ovarian-tumor clone; nonetheless PMID10729222 identifies a C-terminal frameshift in an early EDG4 sequence, and Im10727522 corrected their construct to genomic consensus. Determine which construct each assay used rather than assume every EDG4 result represents either that variant or the canonical protein. Compare direct LPAR2 Gi/cAMP inhibition in16203867 without treating inhibition in one context as universal exclusion of activation in another. Separate conditional functional capacity, assay-system artifact or altered construct, and physiological prevalence. Is activating pathway annotation supported, merely non-core, or unresolved? Do not silently generalize activating to modulating simply because its direction is conditional.
